en-US:
This update improves Office handwriting, presentation charts, iPad text entry, attachment editing and local tasks.

Please test using copies of your files:
- Add ink in Word, Excel and PowerPoint, then save and reopen. Check color, width and Apple Pencil behavior.
- Edit presentation chart labels and values, including Chinese text. Add or remove a series, save and reopen.
- Type a long message on iPad and expand the input field. Send it, visit Notes and return; sent text should stay cleared and new unsent text should remain.
- Open a chat attachment, edit it and return to the same conversation. Start and stop an HTML preview without changing the chat.
- With your AI provider configured, ask for a short local task and a document or image output. Open the result.

Some Office formatting may change when saving. Apple Pencil feel and palm rejection need device testing. The first local environment startup may require a download.

Send feedback from Settings with your device and system version. Remove private content and credentials from screenshots.
zh-Hans:
本次改进了 Office 手写、演示文稿图表、iPad 输入、附件编辑和本地任务。

请使用文件副本重点测试：
- 在 Word、Excel 和 PowerPoint 中添加笔迹，保存重开，检查颜色、线宽和 Apple Pencil 体验。
- 修改演示文稿图表的分类、数值和中文名称，增删数据系列后保存重开。
- 在 iPad 输入长消息并展开输入框。发送后前往手记再返回：已发送的文字应保持清空，新输入的草稿应保留。
- 打开聊天附件编辑，再返回原对话。启动并停止 HTML 预览，确认聊天内容不变。
- 配置自己的 AI 服务后，让助手执行一个简短的本地任务并生成文档或图片，再打开结果。

部分 Office 格式在保存后可能变化。Apple Pencil 手感和手掌防误触仍需实机测试。首次启动本地环境可能需要下载。

请在设置中反馈设备型号、系统版本和问题；分享截图前遮去私人内容及凭据。
